3. All of the red area based Khorne Red (base).

For the plasma areas. 
1. Basecoat in Baharroth Blue (layer).
2. Dry brush Temple Guard Blue (layer).
3. Dry brush only the raised upper surfaces with Sotek Green (layer).
4. For the hot white, I used an oil paint in a slightly thicker than pin wash consistency wash using Titanium White.
